metadata.title: Cube tilings, partition counters, and the Calkin--Wilf and Kepler trees
metadata.abstract: A tiling of the integer lattice $\mathbb{Z}^d$ by translates of the discrete cube $K_d=\{0,1\}^d$ cuts every translate $K_d+x$ into subcubes. We study the function $\ell(x)$ counting these parts. Its sum over every translate of $K_d$ equals $3^d$, for an arbitrary translation set. For lattice tilings with a triangular basis we obtain a dimension-reduction formula, and we describe every cocyclic lattice by a single normalized congruence. Along a cyclic generator, the counter of a signed bidiagonal lattice is a row of Stern's diatomic sequence; pairs of counter values realize the Calkin--Wilf tree, and complementary binary words realize the Kepler tree. For the binary lattice, the translated counter labelings of the cube carry generating face partitions, supplied by the tiling itself, which force the levels of the Kepler tree, and every nontrivial face partition has a unique lamination direction. Using finite Fourier analysis we prove that the ordered cyclic profile determines a standard cocyclic cube tiling lattice up to coordinate reflections. For lattices tiling by discrete boxes we determine exactly when the analogous statement holds.

analysis.progressType: 立方体铺砌分割计数与有理数树
analysis.workSummary: 整数格点被{0,1}^d平移铺砌时，研究每个平移立方体被切成的子立方体数ℓ(x)，证明每个立方体上计数和恒为3^d。对三角基格点给降维式，以规范同余描述cocyclic格点，连接带符号双对角格点沿循环生成元的计数、Stern序列及Calkin–Wilf/Kepler树。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明有序循环轮廓可确定标准cocyclic立方体铺砌格点至坐标反射，并给离散盒子对应判据。
analysis.limitations: 重构结论只在指定标准cocyclic类别中，不能扩大到任意平移铺砌；树实现与一般计数恒等式范围不同。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: PDF第23页详细声明：ChatGPT Astra Pro 6获得定理3.2的同余表示，并回答作者问题给第8节证明；其中第8节结论作者已预期，简化权重与Fourier路线也由作者提出。Claude Opus 5.5合并/编辑稿件、画图、查证明，贡献逐项列明的命题/推论（含9.3、9.4(b)、9.5等）及附录部分，并完成第8节和10.2的计算。定理3.2核心同余构造有具体AI归因，记ideas；同时按声明记proofs/computation/verification/writing，保留上述人类原始路线和预期结论的界限。作者审查核验全部内容并负责。
